law: Every new root seed is first activated by ORCHESTRATE. There is no pre-orchestrator intent cleaner, planner, prompt engineer, maker, checker, or reflector.

intentRefinement.rule: Orchestrator may run a bounded inner PMCR-O cycle and invoke registered reasoning/prompting capabilities to refine the intent hypothesis before outer PLAN.
intentRefinement.plannerReceives: admitted bounded intent hypothesis plus immutable raw-seed reference and admissible evidence

reflectedNextSeed.rule: REFLECT emits exactly one unexecuted next seed; if consumed, it becomes a new root-cycle ingress through ORCHESTRATE.

internalDelegation.rule: A capability handoff inside an already admitted cycle does not restart root ingress; it remains governed by the owning phase/cycle.
